review_findings.F09: Preserve Mongo draft cleanup targets across PostgreSQL teardown mutation
review_findings.F10: Enforce authoritative post-cleanup durable readbacks across storage tiers

A_ownership.name: owned
A_ownership.purpose: Stable, permanent record of all fixture and sentinel identities registered during the test session

B_pending_deletion.name: pending
B_pending_deletion.purpose: Tracks uncompleted cleanup operations; supports fault-tolerant retry without duplicating successful deletions

C_verification.name: verification
C_verification.purpose: Authoritative readback registry verifying true zero-residual storage state across PostgreSQL and MongoDB

cleanup_steps.name: revision_outbox_events
cleanup_steps.action: DELETE FROM revision_outbox_events WHERE novel_id = $1 / chapter_id = $1

cleanup_steps.name: clear_latest_revision_fk
cleanup_steps.action: UPDATE chapters SET latest_revision_id = NULL WHERE chapter_id = $1

cleanup_steps.name: chapter_revisions
cleanup_steps.action: DELETE FROM chapter_revisions per novel, chapter, revision ID

cleanup_steps.name: chapters
cleanup_steps.action: DELETE FROM chapters WHERE chapter_id = $1 per ID

cleanup_steps.name: novels
cleanup_steps.action: DELETE FROM novels WHERE novel_id = $1 per ID

cleanup_steps.name: users
cleanup_steps.action: DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id = $1 per ID

cleanup_steps.name: mongo_draft_chapters
cleanup_steps.action: deleteMany({ chapterId }) per target chapter ID (F-09 target preservation)

cleanup_steps.name: authoritative_fixture_readbacks
cleanup_steps.action: Direct SELECT count(*) and countDocuments(); fail closed if count > 0 (F-10 durable verification)

cleanup_steps.name: sentinel_preservation_verification
cleanup_steps.action: Verify confirmed sentinels read back count === 1 before sentinel teardown

cleanup_steps.name: sentinel_teardown
cleanup_steps.action: DELETE sentinel chapters, novels, users, mongo drafts per ID

cleanup_steps.name: authoritative_sentinel_readbacks
cleanup_steps.action: Direct SELECT count(*) and countDocuments() confirming all sentinels count === 0
